summary: Updated the model for the Pre-Vote update; two model-checking findings and one code-review liveness finding are reproduced on the updated implementation.
validation_limits: Every BFS/simulation run without a finding stopped at its time budget (LIMITED_COVERAGE); no exhaustive pass is claimed.
Three-node model with bounded terms, log indices, messages, elections, Pre-Vote rounds, membership changes, crashes and drops.
Runtime timer guards, IO completion, network delivery and AppendEntries receipt are not traced.
CR-1 is outside the model (followers never receive log entries; no HigherVote step-down).

findings.title: A timer-started Pre-Vote round survives leader establishment and deposes the new Leader
findings.cause: establish_leader keeps Engine::pre_candidate and handle_pre_vote_resp calls elect() on quorum without a role check; RaftCore's filter checks only tracker presence and leader id.
findings.trigger: A Candidate whose election outlives the election timeout starts a Pre-Vote round (timer or Trigger::elect(true)); its real election then wins; a delayed Pre-Vote grant arrives.
findings.consequence: The new Leader starts an election at term+1 (leaderless window while followers hold its lease); the retained Leader object fails try_leader_handler's debug_assert and RaftCore panics in debug builds.

findings.title: A delayed Pre-Vote grant from a node removed between two same-term rounds panics RaftCore
findings.cause: Pre-Vote rounds at an unchanged term reuse the leader id (term+1, self) and RaftCore correlates responses only by leader id; Candidate::grant_by expects the granter to be in the round's frozen quorum set.
findings.trigger: Start a round, remove a granter by a membership change, start another round at the same term (Trigger::elect(true)), and let the removed node's grant to the first round arrive.
findings.consequence: RaftCore panics with 'target not in quorum set' (an expect, also in release builds) and the node stops serving.

findings.title: A rejected Pre-Vote never propagates the higher term: permanent leaderless stall with a live majority
findings.cause: handle_pre_vote_resp never updates the local vote on rejection and Pre-Vote handling is read-only, so a node with the freshest log but a stale term never learns the higher term while higher-term peers fail its log check.
findings.trigger: Five voters: leader replicates an entry only to node 1 and fails; the others elect a leader at a higher term that fails before replicating; node 1 rejoins (3 of 5 alive).
findings.consequence: No live node can pass Pre-Vote; the cluster stays leaderless although a majority is alive and connected; with Pre-Vote disabled the same state recovers.

findings.title: Pre-Vote protocol documentation contradicts the default pre_vote implementation
findings.cause: docs/protocol/pre_vote.md says the default RaftNetworkV2::pre_vote returns Unreachable and that Unreachable counts as a grant; the code synthesizes a granted response and never counts Err as a grant.
findings.trigger: Reading the documentation when implementing a network adapter.
findings.consequence: Implementors may return Unreachable for an unimplemented pre_vote expecting a grant; with Pre-Vote enabled such a node could never pass Pre-Vote. Not demonstrated.
